steps: Parathormone increases blood calcium, while Calcitonin decreases it; they are antagonistic.
Insulin decreases blood glucose, while Glucagon increases it; they are antagonistic.
Aldosterone increases blood pressure by sodium reabsorption, while ANF decreases it by sodium excretion; they are antagonistic.
Relaxin relaxes the pubic symphysis during childbirth, while Inhibin inhibits FSH secretion; they do not have opposite effects.
Therefore, Relaxin and Inhibin are not antagonistic to each other.
